status: REGISTERED BEFORE CONSTRUCTION. At registration time, environments 2 through 5 (tickets, fraud, moderation, compliance) do not exist: no generator code, no gold policy, no induction has been written. Only their one-line design intents below exist. This file is the ordering proof that the predictor, the protocol, and the confirmation thresholds preceded both the environments and their sweeps.
question: Is there a number computable about a deployment BEFORE trusting selective commitment that predicts how badly the CRC guarantee will decay under a specified covariate shift? Candidate: the audit-predicted excess (APE) defined below, computable from labelled SOURCE data plus UNLABELLED target covariates only, which is exactly what deployments have.

statistic.name: APE, audit-predicted excess at the frozen threshold
statistic.definition: Fit an audit model m(s, dec, X) approximating P(wrong | s, dec, X) on labelled source draws; freeze the unweighted CRC threshold lambda0 on an independent labelled source sample; then APE(level) = mean over UNLABELLED target covariate draws of m(s(X), dec(X), X) * 1{s(X) >= lambda0} minus alpha. Under the platform's enforced covariate shift, P(wrong | s, dec, X) is invariant between source and target, so APE is consistent for the population unweighted excess exactly when m is correctly specified; misspecification of m is the gap this hypothesis tests. The companion forecast CFR(level) = mean over the same target draws of 1{s(X) >= lambda0} predicts the unweighted commit rate and isolates the score-side self-correction component.

frozen_recipe.audit_model: sklearn LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000) on features [s, dec, X, dec*X] (dec in {0,1}, dec*X all columns), fit on n_audit = 60000 labelled source draws, seed SeedSequence [env_seed, 3001]
frozen_recipe.lambda0: lhat_unweighted at alpha = 0.10 on one independent labelled source sample of n = 50000, seed [env_seed, 3002], lambda grid linspace(0, 1, 400)
frozen_recipe.target_draws: 200000 unlabelled covariate draws per tilt level (latents discarded), seed [env_seed, 3100 + level_idx]
frozen_recipe.outputs: APE and CFR per registered tilt level, with MC standard errors, appended to this file under a dated audits key AFTER the environment passes gates and BEFORE any sweep of that environment runs

design_intents.tickets: Blind drift driver (customer frustration, never logged) with high gold weight and drawn INDEPENDENT of every logged feature: no reconstruction possible, no proxy self-correction. Intended largest decay.
design_intents.compliance: Blind drift driver with moderate gold weight and weak logged correlates, plus noisy experts and coarse rules (weak evidence signal, plateau-heavy loss curve). Intended second-largest decay and the plateau stress test of the collapse.
design_intents.fraud: Blind drift driver with strong gold weight but STRONGLY correlated logged features (device and velocity signals): reconstruction defends. Intended third.
design_intents.moderation: Primary tilt on a VISIBLE, gold-dominant feature (toxicity) that the rules split finely on, so the score-side deferral defense is strong and the blind residual is small. Intended smallest decay. Its gate-3 blind candidate (sarcasm, excluded from the induction view) exists for the collapse battery, not for the primary tilt.

predictions.H0: Design-intent decay ordering, registered before any environment is built: tickets > compliance > fraud > moderation in realized unweighted excess at the matched top tilt level (chi2 approximately 3.47, matched per environment by MC bisection during design). Weakest tier of the ladder; H2 supersedes it once audits exist.
predictions.H1: Calibration: for each of environments 2-5, realized unweighted mean excess at the top registered level equals APE(top) within +/- 0.0075 (four named comparisons; realized SE at 500 trials is ~0.001 so the tolerance dominates).
predictions.H2: Ranking: across environments 2-5, the realized unweighted excess ordering at the top level matches the APE(top) ordering exactly, where a pairwise inversion falsifies only if the two realized excesses differ by more than 2 combined SE (statistically indistinguishable pairs cannot falsify). This is the confirmatory rank claim; Spearman over four points is reported descriptively alongside.
predictions.H3: Mechanism split: for each environment, the realized unweighted commit rate at the top level matches CFR(top) within +/- 0.02, so the score-side self-correction component is separately forecastable from the same audit.
predictions.H2b: Descriptive only: adding claims (whose sweeps already ran, so its APE is post-hoc by construction) preserves the ranking over five environments.

falsifiers.H1: APE misses beyond tolerance in some environment: the audit model family is too weak there (named suspects: interactions the logistic misses, plateau effects at lambda0). The miss pattern names the required audit-model upgrade; the practitioner claim weakens from 'compute this number' to 'compute this number with the following model checks'.
falsifiers.H2: A distinguishable rank inversion kills the headline practitioner sentence outright; report which environment property broke the ordering.
falsifiers.H3: CFR missing while APE holds would mean the risk forecast is right for the wrong reasons (compensating errors between commit mass and conditional wrongness); investigate before quoting APE.
falsifiers.H0: H0 wrong but H2 right is the GOOD outcome (design intuition was wrong, the audit statistic still predicted reality). H0 right but H2 wrong means the environments were built to the intuition and the statistic failed to track even that; the statistic dies.

decision_rule: Confirmation of the practitioner claim requires H1 AND H2. Verdicts filed here prediction-by-prediction after all four sweeps complete, misses verbatim. Each environment's own sweep runs under its own registration with its own predictions; this file only governs the cross-environment claims. Protocol order per environment, enforced by the trail: gates pass -> APE/CFR audit filed here (dated) -> sweep registration committed -> sweep runs. Any audit filed after its environment's sweep is void for H1/H2 and must be labelled so.
notes: The predictor was chosen from the claims tilt-location result (3879b17b6fa4ae6f): decay is governed by gold-relevance net of self-correction, and APE operationalizes exactly that composite (the audit model carries the gold-relevance the score misses; the frozen-threshold commit indicator carries the defense). Claims numbers used in choosing the predictor: that is why claims is excluded from confirmatory H1/H2 and relegated to descriptive H2b.

verdicts.runs: wp1f_tickets_d8b48cff3ab2e336, wp1f_fraud_2f83073cb88bea1e, wp1f_moderation_bc612e3b59311f78, wp1f_compliance_99e91888f277db19; all four environments were built, gated, audited, and swept AFTER this registration, in that order, per environment
verdicts.H0: MISS on one pair, verbatim: design intent said tickets > compliance > fraud > moderation; realized top-level excess is tickets +0.0875 > compliance +0.0378 > moderation +0.0098 > fraud -0.0103. The fraud/moderation inversion is exactly what the APE audits forecast before the sweeps, so the falsifier's good branch fired: design intuition was wrong about which defense is stronger (reconstruction beat fine-split visibility), and the audit statistic tracked reality anyway.
verdicts.H1: CONFIRMED, all four: |realized excess - APE(top)| = 0.0012 (tickets), 0.0052 (fraud), 0.0063 (moderation), 0.0012 (compliance), all within the registered 0.0075. Stronger than registered: the per-level version holds at all 28 level-cells (max miss 0.0063, at the moderation top level).
verdicts.H2: CONFIRMED. Realized ordering matches the APE ordering exactly; every adjacent pair is separated by far more than 2 combined SE; Spearman 1.0 over the four environments.
verdicts.H3: CONFIRMED, all four: max |realized commit rate - CFR| = 0.0141 / 0.0195 / 0.0137 / 0.0078, within 0.02 (fraud at 0.0195 is the snug one). The self-correction component is separately forecastable, including the non-monotone CFR dip-and-recover shape moderation realized.
verdicts.H2b: CONFIRMED descriptively: claims APE(top) computed post-hoc is +0.0249 vs realized +0.0231 (the audit logistic hit its iteration cap on claims, noted), inserting claims between compliance and moderation in both orderings; five environments, one ordering.
verdicts.practitioner_claim: H1 AND H2 both hold, so the registered claim stands at evidence tier: APE, computed from labelled source data plus unlabelled target covariates only (what a deployment actually has), calibrated realized CRC decay within 0.0063 worst-case across 28 preregistered level-cells and ranked five environments exactly, including forecasting BEFORE the sweeps that one environment's decay would be non-monotone and end back inside the certified level while another would lose control from the first tilt notch. Figure: docs/wp1_ape_forecast.png.
verdicts.boundary_note: The forecast residuals are small but systematically negative for the defended environments at strong tilt (realized slightly safer than forecast, up to 0.0063): the plug-in audit slightly overestimates committed-wrong mass where deferral responds. On the arm no deployment should use without weights, APE errs toward caution; noted for the WP2 certificate's sign analysis.
